scope: Serialized evidence for the campaign entrance door in level1. This file is separate from animation_manifest.json; it records source evidence, not a claim that the clip is triggered by the first open_door interaction.

clip.name: FallingDoor
clip.interpretation: Unity serializes a short looping clip named FallingDoor on the entrance door Animator. The serialized clip has no explicit rotation/position/scale curve arrays; root-transform data is present, but Animator.applyRootMotion is false. These fields do not establish a visible swing angle, pivot, or whether/when the clip is played.

code_evidence.entrance_room_view: EntranceRoomView only exposes background Sprite swaps (BurnBackground/DestroyedBackground); no door animation method is declared.
code_evidence.room_view_base: ARoomView has serialized _door, _brokenDoor, _doorTrigger references; BreakDoor disables linked actionable object and calls IRoomView.BreakDoor (view behavior), rather than demonstrating playback of FallingDoor.
code_evidence.entrance_room: EntranceRoom has EnterInner and ShowFullSizeCharacter; no source-level direct Animator.Play/SetTrigger invocation was established in the audited methods.
code_evidence.peephole: PeepholeTrigger is a camera/distortion and linked-room transition path to ERoom 5. Its DOTween values animate the peephole view effect; they are not evidence that the entrance door leaf animates.
code_evidence.door_trigger: No level1 DoorTrigger with linkedRoom ERoom 5 was found; the six ordinary DoorTrigger records target interior rooms.

conclusion: The main entrance door has an authored Animator Controller and a FallingDoor clip. Available serialized evidence does not prove that the initial open_door action starts that state, and does not prove a hinge/pivot, authored swing angle, or non-looping completion. Do not map FallingDoor to a fabricated rotational transition without additional source evidence.
